summary: Ares Industrial Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to update its net asset value per share as of May 31, 2026, and disclose transaction prices effective July 1, 2026. The filing describes valuation procedures overseen by the board and independent valuation advisor Altus Group U.S. Inc., and provides a table of NAV components. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine periodic NAV disclosure by a non-traded REIT, not a special situation.
